registered_addition_groups.rationale: These attribute assignments declare the exact ctypes return and argument types for the read-only Windows GetCurrentProcess and GetProcessMemoryInfo calls. They correct 64-bit handle and structure marshalling after the first post-merge 8840U gate failed before workload start. The calls only measure this gate process's resident working set for the already reviewed physical receipt; they do not write runtime state, select a production authority path, repair accepted history, activate authority, or add cognition, model, vector, action, network, or speech capability.
